title: Diversified time-series momentum, a 38-market CFD portfolio
system: A portfolio of 38 OANDA CFDs (metals, indices, energies, bonds, ags, forex majors), long or short each month on the sign of its own 12-month return skipping the last month, each at 10 % volatility, equal risk, scaled to 10 % portfolio volatility; net of spread and CFD overnight financing
headline: FAIL: out of sample (2024-01 to 2026-10) -0.3406% a month net, t -0.7031, Sharpe -0.4177; in sample -0.2257% (t -0.5143); replication 2005-19 -0.1338% (t -0.6086)

noMarkup.note: Post hoc, not pre-registered: financing at the rate alone (longs pay r, shorts receive r, forex nothing), i.e. close to a futures excess return with no broker markup

financing.rate: FRED DGS2 weekly (council-data macro/cache.json score.fred), as of, floored at 0; 4.36 % before 6 Jan 2006; same US rate for every currency
financing.forex: markup only, interest differential not charged or credited
